<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/gateway_accounts/{gwa}/balance"}
#docs
A gateway that pays refunds from this balance refuses a refund larger than the available amount. `supported: false` means the gateway has no balance to read. `available: false` means the gateway did not return it; `message` says why and how to correct it (PayPal needs Transaction search enabled on the app). Figures can lag; `as_of` says how far.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `gwa` | `string` | **yes** | The gateway account's id (gwa_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` | no | Three-letter ISO currency code. Returns that currency only. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `gateway_balance`. One of `gateway_balance`. |
| `id` | `string` | The balance's id. |
| `supported` | `boolean` | The supported. |
| `available` | `boolean` | The available. |
| `reason` | `string` | The reason. One of `not_permitted`, `unavailable`. |
| `message` | `string` | The balance's message. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | The as of. |
| `balances` | `array of object` | The balances. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Balance |
| `400` | currency is not a three-letter code |
| `404` | Gateway account not found |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/gateway_accounts/gwa_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/balance" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
